question: Does ModularVisual raw enum choose Warrior/Rogue/Mage/NPC default modules, and should NPCs inherit local player skin?
finding: No raw-enum to class-string mapping was established. Source modular mesh initialization selects stored category default URI from the model. Prince stores __naked defaults; warrior/rogue/mage clothing are available modules selected later by item inventory. NPCs must not inherit player controller substring.

provider.policy: Decode tag13 per scene node. Resolve each stored default URI using original getModuleId category-order search, then apply the returned category-local index to its initialized category. No class/NPC/model-name assumptions. Nonmodular returns empty; unresolved default selects empty; reject invalid index/external refs/extra descriptor array; failure preserves output.

original_policy.finding: Uses serialized category default URI to getModuleId and calls setCategoryModule for each category. No Character class input.
Reads Loot property9, creates items, auto-equips eligible items; updates skin from inventory if already populated.
Direct _InitEquipment call gated by IsLocalPlayer. Non-player content retains authored/model/equipment state; no copying local player selector.
Reads equipped Item ModularModule string, selects category module or __placeholder, uses __naked when unequipped; weapons attach separately.
